summary: Backend is complete and frontend has been instructed to integrate; QA is now queued behind the known unavailable Flask dependency while security can begin a static review.

messages.content: Backend API is complete. Please report completion when the board integration is finished so QA can begin acceptance testing.
Prepare the API/UI acceptance pass, but report the missing Flask dependency and unavailable package network as a blocker if it prevents runtime execution. Capture static checks that remain possible.
Begin the final static security review now: verify API validation/parameterization and frontend safe rendering. Report any runtime checks blocked by the unavailable Flask dependency.
No API change is requested. Remain available to address QA or security findings after their review.

blockers: The environment cannot currently install Flask because package-network access is unavailable; this prevents runtime API and browser end-to-end verification.
decisions: Proceed with static QA/security review while treating runtime validation as an environment blocker, not an implementation completion signal.
